subject: SCCs route & implementation playbook for Wellnest DPA
messages:
From: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
To: kimberly.park@redwood.ai, priyom.das@redwood.ai
Cc: sasha@brightlaw.com, legal@wellnest.com
Date: 2027-05-30T08:12:00Z
Subject: SCCs route & implementation playbook for Wellnest DPA

Team —

Following our intake with Wellnest (UK-based provider), legal asked us to confirm which EU/UK transfer route we will use for their DPA. Options on the table:

- Module 2 (Controller-to-Processor) with UK Addendum: minimal changes, aligns with current infra where Wellnest is controller.
- Module 4 (Processor-to-Processor) / Processor-to-Controller mix: could be needed if Wellnest insists on additional processor obligations for subprocessing.

Two asks:
1) Can we produce a quick implementation playbook that covers both options and a recommended fallback? Include operational evidence requirements (SOC 2 report, DPIA excerpts, logging/audit artifacts).
2) Please confirm any infra constraints for Module 4 (e.g., additional audit logs, contractual Annex requirements).

I've attached an early "SCCs execution checklist" and our current DPA draft (redwood-dpa-v3.pdf) for reference.

Target: finalize recommendation + evidence list by tomorrow EOD so I can circulate to Wellnest legal and BrightLaw.

Thanks —
Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Head of Privacy Ops, Redwood Inference

From: kimberly.park@redwood.ai
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: priyom.das@redwood.ai, sasha@brightlaw.com
Date: 2027-05-30T10:03:00Z
Subject: Re: SCCs route & implementation playbook for Wellnest DPA

Lauren —

Quick notes based on ops review:
- Module 2 is our default for controller->processor relationships. Minimal infra changes.
- Module 4 becomes relevant if Wellnest requires us to act as a subprocessor with stricter obligations (for example, if they require explicit subprocessor audit logs or dedicated data segregation).

Operational considerations (summary):
- Evidence: SOC 2 Type II (last 12 months), KV-cache eviction logs for data retention validation, per-tenant access logs.
- If Module 4 is chosen we should add: transient key rotation logs, per-request region tagging, and an Annex listing sub-processors with specific roles.
- No current blocking technical constraints for Module 4, but a short deployment window (2 weeks) will be needed to surface per-tenant audit tags in our runtime and to bake those into the evidence pack.

Recommended path: propose Module 2 with a Module 4 fallback clause in the DPA (i.e., we commit to Module 2; if Wellnest requires Module 4 we will execute an addendum within X business days). That keeps negotiations moving while buying us time to implement extra evidence if needed.

I pulled together a minimal evidence matrix and put a link in the checklist. Will iterate with Priyom on contract language.

- Kim
Kimberly Park
Director, Infrastructure Security

From: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai

Cc: sasha@brightlaw.com, procurement@wellnest.com
Date: 2027-05-31T14:05:00Z
Subject: Re: SCCs route & implementation playbook for Wellnest DPA

Aisha / team —

Appreciate the clear redlines and the evidence ask. Proposal and next steps below:

Decision (recommended):
- Proceed with Module 2 (Controller->Processor SCCs) for initial signature.
- Include a 30-day Module 4 execution fallback clause in Section 7 ("Processor Role Changes") of the DPA: if Wellnest elects to move to Processor-to-Processor obligations, Redwood will deliver the Module 4 addendum and the additional evidence pack within 30 business days.

Evidence pack we will deliver at signing:
- SOC 2 Type II (full report)
- Redacted DPIA summary + mitigation table (1 page)
- Sub-processor Annex (current list) + commitment to update within 5 business days of new subprocessors
- Execution checklist (attached)

Operational notes for Wellnest / procurement:
- Implementation window for Module 4 (if invoked): 10-14 business days of development + 10 business days for audit evidence compilation.
- DocuSign: we will accept an executed DPA with the Module 2 SCCs now and a separate DocuSign envelope for the Module 4 addendum if/when required. DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.net/1234abcd-wellnest-dpa

Action items:
- Priyom: please draft the Section 7 fallback language and the 30-business-day SLA for delivery of additional evidence.
- Kim: prepare the evidence pack and confirm expected availability date for SOC 2 and DPIA redaction.
- Aisha / Wellnest: confirm acceptance of the fallback approach or propose an alternative SLA.

I'll circulate a redline including Section 7 and the proposed Annex A updates once Priyom and Kim flag the language.

Thanks —
Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Head of Privacy Ops, Redwood Inference
